content: निधा €3 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To place, put, put or set down; शिरसि निदधानोऽञ्जलिपुटम् <ls>Bh. 3. 123</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 50</ls>, <ls n="R. 3.">62</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 52</ls>; <ls>Śi. 1. 13</ls>. .²2 To confide, or entrust, commit to the care of; निदधे विजयाशंसां चापे सीतां च लक्ष्मणे <ls>R. 12. 44</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 36</ls>. .²3 To give, impart to, deposit with; दिनान्ते निहितं तेजः सवित्रेव हुताशनः <ls>R. 4. 1</ls>. .²4 To put down, lay, allay, restrain; सलिलैर्निहितं रजः क्षितौ <ls>Ghaṭ. 1</ls> .²5 To bury, conceal or hide (as under ground); ऊनद्विवार्षिकं प्रेतं निदध्युर्बान्धवा बहिः <ls>Ms. 5. 68</ls>. .²6 To fix or direct the thoughts upon; <ab>cf.</ab> निध्यै. .²7 To determine, resolve. .²8 To direct oneʼs labours, endeavour. .²9 To appoint. .²10 To remove, relinquish. .²11 To lay up, treasure up. .²12 To remember, keep or bear in mind. .²13 To end, close.
निधा <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 Laying snares. .²2 A net or snare.
